name: document-card
description: Document row with file metadata, access status and an optional download action.
designIntent: Deal rooms repeat the same document row. DocumentCard keeps the file type, size, updated date, access state and download action in one consistent row.

props.name: fileType
props.description: Short file type label, such as PDF or XLSX.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Download handler. Omit to render a display-only row.

examples.title: Deal room document
examples.code:
<DocumentCard
  name="Q3-financials.pdf"
  fileType="PDF"
  size="2.4 MB"
  updatedAt="Nov 1, 2026"
  onDownload={download}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't enable download for restricted files
antiPatterns.explanation: The button is disabled unless status is available; access is never implied.

accessibility.implementation: The download button is named Download <file name>
Status is a text badge and the disabled button communicates restriction
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a way to request access outside the row

compositionRules.relationship: DocumentCard is a compact Card row
